scope: Persistent pinned group and pointer/keyboard ordering within each group
Open-project name/ID search with keyboard navigation and IME protection
Overflow controls and active-tab reveal at 1440/960px
Stable editor DOM order, per-project Undo, revisions and comparison positions
Preference write failure/Retry, pinned close/reopen and page reload recovery

targetNode.command: pnpm --filter @agent-webcad/web exec tsx --test tests/projectTabNavigation.test.ts tests/projectWorkspaceStore.test.ts tests/projectComparison.test.ts tests/projectSession.test.ts tests/shortcutRouter.test.ts

invariants: A/B iframe and contentDocument identity, document revisions and Undo histories remain unchanged by tab metadata edits; no additional submitted kernel tasks. Reload restores each checkpoint with fresh Undo sessions.
boundaries: Moves remain within the pinned or ordinary group; pin/unpin changes group
Search includes open projects only; existing Projects manager searches closed projects
No synchronized cameras, arbitrary docking or duplicate editable views of one document
960px is the smallest validated host viewport; no hour-scale memory guarantee
